front: Ward a creature against dangerous spirits, with range and targets scaling by actions spent.
back:
+1 status bonus to saves against spells and effects from spirit-trait creatures and haunts.
1 action: range touch.
2 actions (concentrate): range 30 feet; bonus is +2 if target is living.
3 actions (concentrate): 30-foot emanation; targets you and all allies in it.
Sustain up to 1 minute.
